name: zzM3_eye_night

tests.name: the eye was FOUND on every skin -- some cell of the head responds to the eye level

detail.note: the head is scanned at the eye floor and at the clamp and the cell that moves most IS the eye; a skin with no responding cell is a real finding, not a lost patch

tests.name: every skin was sampled at every hour at every eye level
the world's pinned exposure range is untouched -- the experiment is not confounded

detail.note: min/max EV100 is the world setting and must not move; AutoExposureBias is driven by the hour by the day cycle and is expected to differ

tests.name: driving the eye level actually changes the rendered eye

detail.note: a flat response here is a broken capture, not a finding about the eyes

tests.name: the eye level saturates exactly at SetEyeGlow's clamp and not before

detail.note: the clamp moved 12 -> 30 in this build so EyeGlowDay 18 is finally reachable; every 'eye level' reading in the corpus from before it is really 12 whatever it was set to

tests.name: on every skin the eye level arrives at the rendered EYE and not merely at the head

detail.note: isolation = the eye patch's gain minus the cheek's gain, so a head that glows as a whole cannot pass this; near zero means the emission is not reaching the eye and no knee will fix it

tests.name: the eye is brighter than the face beside it, on every skin at every hour

detail.note: measured against a cheek patch, at eye level 12, which is what the shipped 18 actually resolves to

tests.name: a mascot filling the frame is not blown out at the shipped eye level
and that is not achieved by making the picture dark
the added eye light still points at the skin's authored eye colour

detail.note: cosine of the ADDED light against the authored RGB; measured on the difference so a pale face behind the eye cannot launder a grey eye into looking coloured

tests.name: the eye is a coloured core rather than a white one

detail.note: channel spread of the added light; a white-clipped eye reads near 0

tests.name: at the SHIPPED eye levels the eye reads as a bright core on every skin at every hour -- neither dim nor blown

detail.note: the swept levels pin both ends of the lerp to isolate the level; this row leaves the shipped ratio alone and lets the day cycle interpolate, so it is the only one that says what the game does. Dim = isolation under the floor or the eye no brighter than the cheek; blown = over half the eye patch at 250+

tests.name: the knee's live range at this asset scale is measured, not assumed

detail.note: body glow spans 3.3-13.2 after the 4000->6 re-baseline, so a knee at the shipped 700 compresses nothing; this says where it starts to bite and whether it helps
